criterion_scores.reasoning: Extensively spot-verified: the roadmap.md regex parser matches the real file exactly (tested live in Node against Phase 0-3 headers and A1-A3 anchor rows), ADR-9's PII chokepoint and ADR-10 decision 9 ('attendance is never inferred') are both accurately represented and the event-deep-research/post-event-content substrate-write edges correctly respect D9 (pre-event writes claims but never an event row; post-event creates the attended row), spine_client.py's --selftest/--check-writers/retry claims and retrieve.py's exit-5 claim both check out against the real scripts, and the CLAUDE.md Rule 13 / DoD-gate telemetry-null claims are verbatim-consistent. One real, visible defect found: the YED-226 buildPath item's own why-text claims phase P2 while the generator's roadmap-driven phase computation will render 'now' for it because YED-226 isn't in roadmap.md yet — a rendered self-contradiction inside the exact feature whose job is to make phase/status claims trustworthy. Correctness is also capped short of 1.0 because two of the seven files this map's runtime behaviour depends on (nodes.tsx, model.ts) are outside the artifact, so KIND_GLYPH/STATUS_DOT/EDGE_VERB coverage of the 8 kind values and fileSubgraph's correctness could not be checked.

All nine ACs are addressed by the five included files to the extent checkable: AC1 count (34, in the 25-35 band, verified by parsing the JSON), AC2's six-field panel present verbatim in ComponentPanel, AC3's kind+summary EdgePanel present with a full KIND_HELP map, AC4's file-subgraph structurally implemented in buildFocus (though fileSubgraph itself is in the excluded model.ts), AC5's build-path overlay implemented with the one YED-226 gap above, AC6's status truthfulness independently verified true for topic-intelligence/Granola/Gamma/workflows, AC7's generator+verifier scripts exist and run dependency-ordered checks (though the 'prints added/removed/stale' wording is only a loose proxy — see defect), AC8's deep-link state restoration implemented via useState+searchParams, AC9's layer-2-on-focus lazy import present. No load-bearing file/rubric/doc was found missing (cap not triggered) — the deterministic check and my own spot-check of ~50 paths agree. Docked below 0.85 for the AC7 wording gap and for the residual uncertainty from the explicitly-excluded page.tsx/nodes.tsx/model.ts/package.json, which hold real portions of AC1/AC7/AC9's actual wiring that I could not inspect.

The merge-don't-clobber overlay pattern (curated JSON preserved, facts regenerated) matches the precedent the file itself cites (gen-toolbox); Linear is correctly treated as the live source of truth (the map fetches state at build/runtime rather than caching a snapshot, per linear.ts's own comment); roadmap.md is read as the phase source rather than restated; the PII boundary (ADR-9) is correctly reflected without the map itself touching contact PII. One minor nit: the gtm-suite component's kind="command" doesn't cleanly match its mostly-agent/skill file list (see defect). No hardcoded secrets, no bypass of a guarded write path (this is a read-only surface).

No resurrected tombstones: the three mechanized Granola/Langfuse hits all correctly frame those tools as disabled/rejected history, not live dependencies (verified against memory and CLAUDE.md). No fabricated numbers — component/edge counts and dates are derived from real files and git history, not invented. No orphan metrics. The overlayStale mechanism is itself a deliberate anti-drift feature (exactly the topic-intelligence lesson). However, that same mechanism only catches file-changed-after-reviewed_at drift — it has no check that a buildPath item's own prose phase tag agrees with the roadmap-derived phase it will actually render with, which is precisely how the YED-226 defect got through; this is a mild instance of the same class of duplicated, unreconciled state (phase asserted in free text vs. phase computed from roadmap.md) that the rest of the design otherwise guards against well.

Failure design is honest and loud: the generator exits 1 on any warning and prints emptyPatterns/unmapped/overlayStale explicitly rather than swallowing them; the verifier script enumerates every problem class (component-count band, unknown zone, missing why, status-without-reason, dangling edges) and exits 1 with a full list; linear/issues.ts openly returns null and lets the UI say 'Linear state unknown (not reachable at build)' rather than guessing; the gtm-suite component candidly discloses it has 'No PRD or Linear issue of their own — flagged in WORKFLOWS.md' rather than hiding the gap. No claim in the artifact is stamped 'verified' without backing that I could find. Docked slightly for the AC7 output-labelling gap (a maintainer reading the console output wouldn't obviously map it back to the PRD's 'added/removed/stale' language) and because I could not confirm the excluded nodes.tsx/model.ts don't themselves overclaim a property (e.g. a docstring promising completeness) since they weren't in scope.

defects.quote: "why": "Identity tier-1 in DDL — the parked half of entity dedup (P2)."
defects.explanation: YED-226 does not appear anywhere in .claude/references/roadmap.md (grepped the full file — zero hits), yet this buildPath item's own `why` text asserts phase P2. gen-system-map.mjs computes `phase: rm.issuePhase.get(it.issue) ?? "now"` (line 1849) purely from roadmap.md's phase tables via regex, so at generation time this item's rendered phase badge will read 'now' / 'in flight now' (PlannedPanel line ~2560/2696-2697) while the same panel's 'Why' section still prints the '(P2)' text a few lines below it — a visible, self-contradicting claim inside the exact overlay this PRD's north-star guardrail ('0 status contradictions') exists to prevent. I confirmed the three other buildPath items also absent from roadmap.md (YED-229, YED-230, YED-231) carry no phase claim in their why text, so they fall back cleanly with no contradiction — YED-226 is a genuine, isolated drift between the curated overlay and the roadmap the generator actually reads.

AC7 requires the generator to 'print added/removed/stale'. The script's actual console output labels are 'pattern(s) match no graph node' (line 1889), 'graph file(s) mapped to no component' / the unmapped bucket (line 1890), and 'overlay STALE' (line 1891/1939) — a reasonable proxy for removed/added/stale respectively, but not literally an added/removed diff against the previous generation. A reviewer checking AC7 verbatim would not immediately recognize this mapping; it works but the wording gap is real.

The 'GTM research & copy suite' component (id gtm-suite) is tagged kind="command" but its files array is dominated by agents (.claude/agents/sales-methodology/**, several .../research/*.md) and skills (.claude/skills/cold-email/**, .claude/skills/conducting-user-interviews/**) rather than commands. A minor categorization looseness for a component that is explicitly a mixed 'suite' — not misleading, but not a clean kind match either.
